description.value: Sulphurous Lake Resort is a year-round lakeside retreat in BC's Cariboo region offering cabins, RV sites, and tent camping with communal shower and washroom facilities. Cabins are fully equipped with cooking appliances, hot and cold running water, and bedding basics, making it a comfortable basecamp for cyclists exploring the Central Interior. The property is pet-friendly and allows campfires subject to seasonal fire regulations.

address.value: 6045 Mahood Lake Rd, Lone Butte, BC V0K 1X3, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and content-rich. The FAQ page confirms cabins, RV, and tent camping with communal shower/toilet facilities, hot/cold running water, ice availability, and online/on-site reservations via a 'Book Now' button. OSM has no tags beyond name and coordinates, so the website is the sole evidence source for all amenity fields. No address or phone is in OSM; the phone (+1 778-444-6045) and email come from the website footer.
concerns: No physical address available in OSM or on the website; exact location can only be inferred from coordinates.
Website notes 'Full new website very soon', suggesting content may be in transition and some details could change.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable resort with camping, cabins, and RV sites in a remote Cariboo location — clearly useful to touring cyclists seeking accommodation in this region.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email contact also available: reserve.sulphurouslakeresort@gmail.com. Winter stays have a 3-night minimum due to infrastructure requirements (water/heat activation).
